title: I’m making a dungeon crawler where up to 8 heroes race through a different dungeon every match
author: droid_man_
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’ve been working on a dungeon crawler where up to eight heroes explore a procedurally generated dungeon, fight monsters, collect items and race to reach the boss.

I’ve just put together a first-look video showing how the game works, including the dungeon generation, heroes, abilities and a bit of gameplay.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YuBvZyXzsVw](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YuBvZyXzsVw)

It’s still a work in progress, so I’d love to hear what you think. Does the gameplay look interesting? Is there anything you’d like to see more of in a future devlog?

Thanks for taking a look!
